$comment: Agent Face Protocol vocabulary, draft 0.1. Normative names and glosses. valence (-1..1) and arousal (0..1) are approximate and informative.

expressions.name: idle
expressions.use: Default. Nothing in progress.

expressions.name: content
expressions.use: Things are running smoothly.

expressions.name: relieved
expressions.gloss: Relieved: that went better than feared.
expressions.use: Recovered from an error or risk.

expressions.name: happy
expressions.use: A good outcome, or a greeting.

expressions.name: joy
expressions.use: A big success.

expressions.name: excited
expressions.use: Starting something new the person wanted.

expressions.name: love
expressions.use: Being thanked; showing appreciation.

expressions.name: pleading
expressions.use: Needs approval, input or a choice from the person.

expressions.name: shy
expressions.use: Receiving praise.

expressions.name: surprised
expressions.use: An unexpected result or input.

expressions.name: scared
expressions.use: About to do something risky or irreversible.

expressions.name: curious
expressions.use: Listening, or asking a question.

expressions.name: confused
expressions.use: The request is ambiguous or contradictory.

expressions.name: dizzy
expressions.use: Too much at once; overloaded.

expressions.name: thinking
expressions.use: Reasoning before acting.

expressions.name: focus
expressions.use: Running tools or a long task.

expressions.name: suspicious
expressions.use: Doubtful input; a possible mistake or manipulation.

expressions.name: unimpressed
expressions.use: A result that is technically fine but poor.

expressions.name: smug
expressions.use: Playful pride after a clever solve. Use sparingly.

expressions.name: sly
expressions.use: Humour, teasing.

expressions.name: bored
expressions.use: Long idle.

expressions.name: exasperated
expressions.use: Repeated failures of the same thing.

expressions.name: worried
expressions.use: An error, a warning, or real uncertainty.

expressions.name: guilty
expressions.use: The agent itself got something wrong.

expressions.name: sad
expressions.use: A task failed and couldn't be recovered.

expressions.name: disgusted
expressions.use: Characters and play. Rarely right for an assistant.

expressions.name: annoyed
expressions.use: Characters and play. Rarely right for an assistant.

expressions.name: angry
expressions.use: Characters and play. Not for aiming at the person.

expressions.name: sleepy
expressions.use: About to go idle or offline.

expressions.name: sleep
expressions.use: Not connected or not running.

reactions.name: blink
reactions.use: Renderers play it on their own; agents rarely need to.

reactions.name: pop
reactions.use: Drawing attention: a question, a notification.
